This is the multi-arch build of [4.19.4](/releases/hotloop-4-19-4/) and nothing else. The code is the same commit's code with the version bumped: no fix, no feature, no change in behavior.

4.19.4 was built for amd64 alone, so that it could reach production and read stable before the arm images were built. 4.19.5 builds the full set: the Gateway for amd64 and arm64, and Edge, IoT and the Edge Relay for amd64, arm64 and arm/v7. A box on arm moves from the images it was running to 4.19.4's code by pulling `stable`.

Read [4.19.4's notes](/releases/hotloop-4-19-4/) for everything that changed since the last published release.

- All four charts (`hotloop`, `hotloop-iot`, `hotloop-edge`, `hotloop-edge-relay`) are at 4.19.5, with every earlier version still in the index.
- `release.yml` builds every platform again (`BUILD_ONLY` is empty). The next release that carries changes sets it back to `linux/amd64`.
